heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1P handles Elegoo Rapid PETG out of the box with exceptional reliability, requiring no enclosure or hardened nozzle upgrades. Operating within its 20 mm³/s volumetric flow limit, you can safely achieve sustained print speeds up to 238 mm/s without experiencing under-extrusion.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with liquid glue or glue stick as a release agent
slicerTweaks: Set Maximum Volumetric Speed to 20 mm³/s in the filament profile to cap print speed near 238 mm/s for 0.2mm layers.
Enable Wipe While Retracting with a 1.5mm distance to prevent PETG nozzle buildup and travel oozing.
Set Pressure Advance (PA) to 0.038 s for the direct drive extruder to eliminate corner bulging at high speeds.
Lower auxiliary part cooling fan to 0% and keep main part cooling between 20-60% to maintain high interlayer bonding strength.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Stringing and fine whisker buildup during travel moves
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG absorbs ambient moisture quickly, decreasing viscosity and increasing drool during rapid traverses.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry filament at 65°C for 6 hours, then in OrcaSlicer enable 'Avoid Crossing Walls' and set retraction to 0.8mm at 35 mm/s.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: PEI surface damage or chunk tearing during print removal
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG forms an aggressive chemical bond to smooth and textured PEI surfaces when heated above 70°C.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply a thin layer of PVP glue stick or liquid glue as an interface/release barrier before printing, and let the bed drop below 35°C before part removal.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Weak layer adhesion and brittle parts along the Z-axis
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excessive cooling from the P1P printhead fan quenching the extruded bead too quickly for proper polymer chain interdiffusion.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Reduce cooling fan maximum to 60%, ensure auxiliary cooling fan is disabled (0%), and bump nozzle temperature to 245°C.

faq.question: Does printing Elegoo Rapid PETG on the P1P require an enclosed chamber?
faq.answer: No, PETG does not require a heated chamber and prints reliably in the open-frame P1P without excessive warping risks.

faq.question: Can the stock stainless steel nozzle handle Elegoo Rapid PETG?
faq.answer: Yes, standard Elegoo Rapid PETG is non-abrasive and will not degrade or wear the stock stainless steel nozzle on the P1P.

faq.question: Why is a glue stick recommended on a textured PEI plate for PETG?
faq.answer: PETG bonds overly aggressively to PEI coatings; the glue acts as a sacrificial release agent to prevent permanent bed damage upon part removal.

faq.question: What is the true practical speed limit for Elegoo Rapid PETG on the P1P?
faq.answer: At a standard 0.2mm layer height and 0.42mm line width, the 20 mm³/s volumetric flow limit allows a maximum safe speed of 238 mm/s.
